Name: Fractured Shell
Description: You touch a willing creature, forcing spiked bone plates to grow and pierce through its skin. They take 1 point of piercing damage. For the duration of the spell, the first time each turn that the target is hit with a melee attack, the attacking creature takes 2d4 piercing damage.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage dealt to attacking creatures increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 1st. When cast using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the spell does not require concentration.
Sourcebook: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt
